US_AIRCRAFT_GROUND_SUPPORT.description: Ground equipment for servicing, testing and handling aircraft. Platform-specific support can be attributed to its aircraft when the purchase identifies the programme.

US_NAVAL_WEAPONS_AND_LAUNCH_SYSTEMS.name: Common naval weapons and launch systems
US_NAVAL_WEAPONS_AND_LAUNCH_SYSTEMS.description: Separately purchased naval guns, launch systems and defensive equipment with shared or unspecified ship-class scope.

US_AIR_AND_MISSILE_DEFENSE.name: Integrated Air and Missile Defence
US_AIR_AND_MISSILE_DEFENSE.description: Counter-UAS, air defence, ballistic missile defence and the sensors and battle management that connect them.

US_MAINTENANCE_SUSTAINMENT.name: Common maintenance and sustainment
US_MAINTENANCE_SUSTAINMENT.description: Depot overhaul, field maintenance and through-life support serving several programmes or where the funded platform is unspecified. Verified aircraft, ship and ground-system maintenance belongs under the programme it supports.

US_FOOD_CLOTHING_GENERAL_SUPPLIES.description: Subsistence, clothing, individual equipment and general supplies.
